# Ulta Beauty
> Ulta Beauty is a beauty retailer offering makeup, skincare, haircare, fragrance, salon services, and a loyalty program online and in stores.

Ulta.com combines a large beauty product catalog with brand shops, how-to content, gift guides, store services, and member benefits through Ulta Beauty Rewards. The site supports shopping by category, concern, brand, and occasion, along with store pickup, salon booking, and promotions.

## Main Shopping Categories
- [Homepage](https://www.ulta.com/): Main shopping entry point for beauty products, offers, rewards, and store services.
- [Makeup](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup): Browse cosmetics including face, lips, eyes, nails, and makeup tools.
- [Skin Care](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care): Shop cleansers, moisturizers, serums, treatments, and skincare tools.
- [Hair](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair): Explore shampoo, conditioner, styling products, treatments, and hair tools.
- [Fragrance](https://www.ulta.com/shop/fragrance): Shop perfumes, colognes, body mists, and fragrance gift sets.
- [Bath & Body](https://www.ulta.com/shop/bath-body): Browse body wash, lotion, scrubs, hand care, and personal care.
- [Tools & Brushes](https://www.ulta.com/shop/tools-brushes): Find makeup brushes, applicators, mirrors, and beauty accessories.
- [Nails](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/nails): Shop nail polish, treatments, press-ons, and manicure essentials.

## Makeup
- [Face Makeup](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face): Shop foundation, concealer, primer, blush, bronzer, and setting products.
- [Eye Makeup](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/eyes): Browse mascara, eyeliner, eyeshadow, brows, and eye primers.
- [Lip Makeup](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/lips): Find lipstick, gloss, liner, balm, stains, and lip care.
- [Foundation](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/foundation): Compare liquid, powder, stick, and serum foundations by finish and coverage.
- [Concealer](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/concealer): Shop concealers for brightening, spot coverage, and color correction.
- [Face Primer](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/face-primer): Browse primers for smoothing, gripping, blurring, and hydration.
- [Mascara](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/eyes/mascara): Explore volumizing, lengthening, tubing, and waterproof mascara formulas.
- [Lipstick](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/lips/lipstick): Shop lipstick in matte, satin, cream, and longwear finishes.

## Skin Care
- [Cleansers](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/cleansers): Browse face washes, cleansing balms, oils, and exfoliating cleansers.
- [Moisturizers](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/moisturizers): Shop creams, gels, lotions, and barrier-supporting moisturizers.
- [Serums](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/treatments/serums): Find hydrating, brightening, anti-aging, and clarifying serum formulas.
- [Treatments](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/treatments): Explore targeted skincare for acne, dark spots, texture, and firmness.
- [Eye Treatments](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/eye-treatments): Shop eye creams, gels, patches, and depuffing treatments.
- [Sun Care](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/suncare): Browse facial sunscreen, body SPF, and after-sun products.
- [Masks](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/treatments/masks): Find sheet masks, clay masks, overnight masks, and peels.
- [Skin Tools](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/tools): Shop cleansing brushes, facial devices, rollers, and skincare tools.

## Hair Care
- [Shampoo & Conditioner](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair/shampoo-conditioner): Browse cleansing and conditioning products for all hair types.
- [Hair Treatments](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair/treatments): Shop masks, oils, bond repair, scalp care, and leave-in treatments.
- [Styling Products](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair/styling-products): Find gels, mousses, sprays, creams, and heat protectants.
- [Hair Color](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair/hair-color): Explore at-home hair color, root touch-up, toner, and gloss.
- [Hair Tools](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair/hair-styling-tools): Shop dryers, flat irons, curling irons, and multi-stylers.
- [Curly Hair](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair/curly-hair): Browse curl-focused cleansers, stylers, masks, and refresh products.
- [Scalp Care](https://www.ulta.com/shop/hair/treatments/scalp-care): Find scalp scrubs, serums, dandruff care, and balancing treatments.

## Fragrance & Bath
- [Perfume](https://www.ulta.com/shop/fragrance/womens-perfume): Shop women’s perfume in floral, fresh, warm, and woody scent families.
- [Cologne](https://www.ulta.com/shop/fragrance/mens-cologne): Browse men’s cologne, parfum, and fragrance gift options.
- [Body Mists & Sprays](https://www.ulta.com/shop/fragrance/body-mists-body-sprays): Find lightweight fragrance mists and body sprays.
- [Fragrance Gift Sets](https://www.ulta.com/shop/fragrance/gift-sets): Shop perfume and cologne sets for gifting and discovery.
- [Body Lotion & Cream](https://www.ulta.com/shop/bath-body/body-moisturizers): Browse body lotions, creams, butters, and body oils.
- [Bath & Shower](https://www.ulta.com/shop/bath-body/bath-shower): Shop body wash, shower gels, bath soaks, and scrubs.
- [Hand Cream & Soap](https://www.ulta.com/shop/bath-body/hand-foot-care): Find hand creams, foot care, and everyday treatment products.

- [Best Sellers](https://www.ulta.com/shop/best-sellers): Popular products frequently purchased across the Ulta assortment.

- [The Ordinary](https://www.ulta.com/brand/the-ordinary): Brand shop for targeted skincare treatments and serums.
- [Dyson](https://www.ulta.com/brand/dyson): Brand page for premium hair styling tools and accessories.
- [OLAPLEX](https://www.ulta.com/brand/olaplex): Brand shop for bond-building hair repair and maintenance products.
- [Tarte](https://www.ulta.com/brand/tarte): Brand page featuring makeup, complexion products, and beauty sets.

## Offers, Gifts & Value
- [Sale](https://www.ulta.com/shop/sale): Discounted beauty products across makeup, skincare, haircare, and tools.
- [Coupons](https://www.ulta.com/coupons): Current coupon offers, exclusions, and savings opportunities.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.ulta.com/giftcards): Purchase physical or digital gift cards for Ulta Beauty.
- [Gifts by Price](https://www.ulta.com/shop/gifts/gifts-by-price): Browse gift ideas organized by budget and price range.
- [Gift Sets](https://www.ulta.com/shop/gifts/gift-sets): Shop curated beauty gift sets across categories and brands.
- [Travel Size](https://www.ulta.com/shop/travel-size): Find mini and TSA-friendly products for trial and travel.
- [Buy Online, Pick Up in Store](https://www.ulta.com/guestservices/buy-online-pick-up-in-store): Details on store pickup and curbside order fulfillment.

## Rewards, Account & Services
- [Ulta Beauty Rewards](https://www.ulta.com/rewards): Loyalty program overview, points earning, tiers, and member benefits.
- [Ultamate Rewards Credit Card](https://www.ulta.com/creditcards): Credit card benefits, application details, and rewards information.
- [Account Sign In](https://www.ulta.com/login): Customer login for orders, rewards, saved items, and account settings.
- [Order Status](https://www.ulta.com/orderstatus): Check order progress and shipment details for recent purchases.
- [Store Locator](https://www.ulta.com/stores): Find nearby Ulta Beauty stores, hours, and available services.
- [The Salon at Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/beautyservices): Overview of salon services offered at participating store locations.
- [Book an Appointment](https://www.ulta.com/beautyservices/book-appointment): Schedule salon and beauty service appointments online.

## Help & Policies
- [Guest Services](https://www.ulta.com/guestservices): Customer support hub for orders, shipping, returns, and account help.
- [Shipping Information](https://www.ulta.com/guestservices/shipping): Shipping methods, delivery timing, and related policies.
- [Returns](https://www.ulta.com/guestservices/returns): Return policy details for online and in-store purchases.
- [Accessibility](https://www.ulta.com/accessibility): Accessibility statement and support information for site users.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.ulta.com/privacy): Privacy practices covering data collection, use, and customer choices.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.ulta.com/terms): Legal terms governing use of the site and services.
- [Contact Us](https://www.ulta.com/guestservices/contact-us): Customer service contact options and support resources.

## Content & Inspiration
- [Discover](https://www.ulta.com/discover): Editorial beauty content, trends, routines, and product recommendations.
- [Makeup Guides](https://www.ulta.com/discover/makeup): Articles and inspiration focused on makeup looks and techniques.
- [Skin Care Guides](https://www.ulta.com/discover/skin-care): Educational content about routines, ingredients, and skincare concerns.
- [Hair Guides](https://www.ulta.com/discover/hair): Styling ideas, product education, and haircare routine content.
- [Fragrance Guides](https://www.ulta.com/discover/fragrance): Fragrance education, scent family explainers, and gifting ideas.
- [Gift Guides](https://www.ulta.com/discover/gifting): Seasonal and occasion-based beauty gift recommendations.
